name: bleach-mirrors-high-launch-oct-28
note: رسمي: Bandai Namco's official site (news 69866, 27 Oct): BLEACH Mirrors High releases 28 Oct 2026 (UTC) on iOS and Android, free to play with in-app purchases, playable after launch maintenance; new story after the Thousand-Year Blood War, new characters by Tite Kubo; languages JA, EN, FR, DE, TC, KO (no Arabic). No usable official video (the site's trailer is 264x150), so stills: the App Store's official art cropped clear of its English banners; one image left out (outfit).
